what: Proposed SquadWeapons.Order for every China infantry unit (Freedom Arrow), following the vanilla US/RU display-order pattern.
field: SquadWeapons.Order -> Weapons.InfantryWeaponOrder (runtime). Display order only: Arsenal card + in-battle unit weapon list. Does not change which weapon fires.
weapon_channel_and_priority: Keep Weapons.WeaponChannel = 0 and Weapons.WeaponPriority = 0 for every infantry weapon (vanilla: all 812 weapon rows are 0/0).
data_source: vanilla rows (lateralus-infantry-20261110/vanilla) + dev-wt releases/0.6/source/UserData/FreedomArrow/constants (codex/development-local 657d31e1); squad tables identical to 091-wt
rule: 1: rifle / assault rifle / battle rifle / SMG
ties: more carriers first, then lower weapon Id
numbering: 1..n per unit (29 of 38 vanilla ordered squads start at 1)

summary.vanilla_rule_check: 37/38 explicitly ordered vanilla squads reproduced exactly by the rule
